contract:
## Shared Types
- `MarsFact`: `{ id: string, title: string, description: string, image_url: string, facts: string[] }`
- `SoundTrigger`: `{ id: string, url: string, event: 'hover' | 'click' | 'scroll' | 'load' }`
- API Response envelope: `{ status: 'ok' | 'error', data?: MarsFact[] | SoundTrigger[], message?: string }`
- Animation Config: `{ selector: string, type: 'rotate' | 'pulse' | 'path', duration: number, easing: string }`

## API Contract
- `GET /api/mars/data` -> Returns `MarsFact[]`
- `GET /api/mars/sounds` -> Returns `SoundTrigger[]`
- `GET /` -> Serves `index.html`
- All API routes return JSON with `Content-Type: application/json`
- Error handling returns 4xx/5xx with `{ status: 'error', message: string }`

## Naming Conventions
- Python: `snake_case` for functions/vars, `PascalCase` for classes, module names lowercase
- JS: `camelCase` for functions/vars, `PascalCase` for classes/constructors, `SCREAMING_SNAKE` for constants
- CSS: `kebab-case` for class names, BEM structure (`block__element--modifier`)
- HTML: semantic elements, `data-*` attributes for JS hooks, lowercase tags
- Assets: `kebab-case` for filenames, organized by type (`/assets/svg/`, `/assets/audio/`)

scaffold_files.content:
"""Pydantic models for API data validation."""
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import List, Literal

class MarsFact(BaseModel):
    id: str
    title: str
    description: str
    image_url: str
    facts: List[str]

class SoundTrigger(BaseModel):
    id: str
    url: str
    event: Literal["hover", "click", "scroll", "load"]

class ApiResponse(BaseModel):
    status: Literal["ok", "error"]
    data: List[MarsFact] | List[SoundTrigger] | None = None
    message: str | None = None
Overview Surface Missions

subtasks.task: User can load the site and navigate the base layout with responsive styling
acceptance_criteria: FastAPI serves index.html at GET /
Base CSS variables and layout structure are applied correctly
Navigation links are visible and styled with hover effects
Hero section contains the SVG container and is centered

subtasks.task: User can fetch Mars data and sound metadata via the API
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/mars/data returns valid MarsFact[] matching Pydantic schema
GET /api/mars/sounds returns valid SoundTrigger[] matching Pydantic schema
API routes are mounted under /api/mars prefix
Static JSON data file is structured correctly for seeding

subtasks.task: User can see interactive SVG animations on the hero section
acceptance_criteria: SVG engine initializes and attaches to #mars-hero-svg
Path drawing and rotation animations trigger correctly
Scroll-triggered animations respond to viewport position
Animations use CSS transforms or SMIL for performance

subtasks.task: User can hear contextual sound effects on interactions
acceptance_criteria: Web Audio API context is created on init
Sound triggers register and play on hover/click/scroll
Audio manager loads sound manifest from API
Ambient loops can be started/stopped without blocking UI

subtasks.task: User can view Mars content sections with dynamic data binding
acceptance_criteria: Content sections render dynamically from fetched MarsFact data
Fact cards use BEM CSS classes and match design tokens
Data binding updates DOM without full page reloads
Components handle missing or malformed data gracefully

subtasks.task: User gets a fully integrated, polished interactive experience
acceptance_criteria: All systems (audio, animations, data, components) initialize in correct order
Utility functions (debounce, fetch wrappers) work without errors
Requirements.txt lists all backend dependencies
End-to-end flow loads data, renders UI, plays sounds, and animates SVGs
